name: Securities Balance Type 1 Code
definition: Specifies the nature of the securities or investment fund balance.

BLOK.name: Blocked
BLOK.definition: Balance of securities that are blocked or frozen. A financial instrument may be unavailable due to external circumstances such as a court order, death of beneficiary or account owner, or bankruptcy.

BORR.name: Borrowed
BORR.definition: Balance of securities that have been borrowed from another party.

COLI.name: Collateral In
COLI.definition: Balance of securities that belong to a third party and that are held for the purpose of collateralisation.

COLO.name: Collateral Out
COLO.definition: Balance of securities that belong to the safekeeping account indicated within this message, and are deposited with a third party for the purpose of collateralisation.

LOAN.name: On Loan
LOAN.definition: Balance of securities that have been loaned to a third party.

MARG.name: Derivatives Margin
MARG.definition: Balance of securities that are used as collateral for derivatives.

PDMT.name: Pending Delivery Matched Balance
PDMT.definition: Balance of securities pending delivery that have been matched. This is only applicable in a CSD to participant communication.

PRMT.name: Pending Receipt Matched Balance
PRMT.definition: Balance of securities pending receipt that have been matched. This is only applicable in a CSD to participant communication.

PRUM.name: Pending Receipt Unmatched Balance
PRUM.definition: Balance of securities pending receipt that are unmatched. This is only applicable in a CSD to participant communication.

PECA.name: Pending Corporate Action
PECA.definition: Balance of securities, before ex-date, that are involved in a corporate action (CA). Securities blocked due to a CA, for example, proxi, in escrow, are to be identified in the BLOK sub-balance.

PEND.name: Pending Delivery
PEND.definition: Balance of securities that are pending delivery.

PENR.name: Pending Receipt
PENR.definition: Balance of securities that are pending receipt.

PLED.name: Pledged
PLED.definition: Balance of securities that are pledged, for example, a financial instrument is unavailable because it has been used or given as a guarantee.

PDUM.name: Pending Delivery Unmatched Balance
PDUM.definition: Balance of securities pending delivery that are unmatched. This is only applicable in a CSD to participant communication.

REGO.name: Out For Registration
REGO.definition: Balance of securities currently being processed by the institution responsible for registering the new beneficial owner (or nominee) of securities after a transaction has settled.

RSTR.name: Restricted
RSTR.definition: Balance of securities that may only be sold under certain conditions or require legal documents.

OTHR.name: Unclassified
OTHR.definition: Balance of securities that is unclassified, ie, is not identified with one of the existing sub-balance types.

TRAN.name: In Transshipment
TRAN.definition: Balance of physical securities that are in transshipment, eg, in the process of being transferred from one depository or agent to another.

DRAW.name: Drawn
DRAW.definition: Balance of securities that are drawn for redemption.

WDOC.name: Waiting Documentation
WDOC.definition: Financial instrument is unavailable due to missing or incomplete documentation pertaining to the account, or due to a missing or incomplete order.

BTRA.name: Being Transferred
BTRA.definition: Financial instrument is unavailable as a result of a transfer order, pending movement in the shareholders' register.
